name: Point Cloud Volumetric Rendering via 2D Atlas
definition: A real-time GPU-accelerated technique for rendering 3D volumetric data (specifically point clouds or scalar fields) by storing the volume in a 2D texture atlas and rendering it as a point cloud where each point represents a voxel/sample. The depth of each sample is encoded in the atlas layout to allow correct sorting and rendering order without traditional depth buffering for the volume itself.
summary: Point Cloud Volumetric Rendering via 2D Atlas is a real-time GPU technique that stores 3D volume data in a 2D texture atlas to render point clouds without traditional depth buffering.
